profile.blacklist_warning:
Warning: Don't lose your Kobool membership by violating the rules by writing your personal information or unaccepted statements.
Don't try to conseal unaccepted text to pass the supervisors eyes,
this will lead to even rejecting your apology if caught.
profile.mu_mate: You have been connected to this member via Acceptance Matching.
profile.unk_kobool:
We can't tell if this member has added you to his/her Acceptance List.
There are three possibilites:
  1. This member has added you to his/her Acceptance List and chose not to show his/her acceptance to you.
  2. This member has added you to his/her Acceptance List and chose to show his/her acceptance to you but he/she is connected to other member right now. In this case Kobool hides his/her acceptance to others as long as he/she is connected already.
  3. This member has not added you to his/her Acceptance List.
Only the first case gives you an option to match with this member if you added him/her to your acceptance list.
profile.no_kobool:
You haven't added this member to your Acceptance List.
As a result there is no chance that you will be matched with this member.
profile.no_kobool_chance:
There is no chance that this member has added you to his/her Acceptance List.
Because he/she hasn't visited your page yet.
You can't match with this member unless both of you add each others to your Acceptance Lists.
profile.wisher:
This member has added you to his/her Acceptance List and chose to show his/her acceptance to you.
You can be matched with this member in the Next Acceptance Matching if you add him/her to your Acceptance List and your rank was than others.
profile.show_pics: Click here to show/hide the Photo Album
profile.in_wishlist:
You added this member to your Acceptance List and this could lead to matching the two of you via Kobool Acceptance Matching process.
Click here to review your list and the "Ranking" of whom you accepted as possible future mates.
profile.add_fav: Add this member to your 'Acceptance List' if you have preliminary acceptance for marriage towards this member.
profile.visit_count:
This line shows the number of times '%m%' visited your page. This number doesn't indicate that %m% is accepting you,
but larger number of visits indicates larger possibility of acceptance by %m%.
profile.page_thumbs: Current results page thumbnails. Click on a thumbnail to display the full details. Use the side buttons to view the next or previous thumbnail page.
profile.main_pic: %m%'s main picture, size is reduced from the original size. Click on this picture to view %m%'s Picture Album with original sizes.
profile.free_text_warning:
Important warning:
We review any text you write in your page and will immediately terminate your membership if you write any of the following:
  • Improper words.
  • Personal contact information. i.e.: phone number, e-mail, address, etc..
  • Personal messages to other Kobool members.
  • none-understandable statements.

wishlist.make_visible:
You chose not to show your Acceptance to this member.
Click here to show your Acceptance.
Showing or hiding your Acceptance will not affect the Acceptance Matching operation.
You can still be matched with this member if he/she added you to his/her Acceptance List.
Showing your Acceptance only helps to motivate this member to add you to his/her Acceptance List if there is Acceptance from his/her side.
(note: Showing your acceptance is not visible to anyone except the member you are accepting)
wishlist.make_invisible:
You chose to show your Acceptance to this member.
Click here to hide this Acceptance.
Showing or hiding your acceptance does not affect the Acceptance Matching operation.
wishlist.promote: Promot this profile, this will give '%m%' higher priority in the next Acceptance Matching.
wishlist.demote: Demote this profile, this will give '%m%' lower priority in the next Acceptance Matching.
